_doc: Emberlight style baseline for tests/client_smoke/style_check.gd (art bible, Colour). shots: the noon and night spawn shots' colour measures (llvmpipe, 1280x720, HUD masked). big: a move this far away from the art bible fails the Test check. small: a move this far either way is printed for the integrator. A world PR that changes the look on purpose reruns the check with --write-baseline and says so.
